facts.text: Quadrotor-v0 is registered to rotorpy.learning.quadrotor_environments:QuadrotorEnv
QuadrotorEnv inherits stable-baselines3's VecEnv, so it is a vectorized environment rather than a gymnasium.Env
The default control abstraction is cmd_vel
The metadata lists cmd_motor_speeds, cmd_motor_thrusts, cmd_ctbr, cmd_ctbm, cmd_vel and cmd_ctatt as the control modes
The cmd_vel action space is Box(-1, 1, shape=(3,))
Every other control mode uses Box(-1, 1, shape=(4,))
The observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=(13,))
The observation concatenates position (3), velocity (3), quaternion (4) and body rates (3), so it has 13 values
The default simulation rate is 100 Hz
The simulation step is 1/sim_rate
The default maximum session time is 10 s
A step is done when the elapsed time reaches max_time
A step is out of bounds when a velocity or body rate exceeds 100 or the position leaves the world extents
The default world is empty free space with bounds -4 to 4 on each axis (wbound = 4)
The cmd_vel action is rescaled to [-max_vel, max_vel]
max_vel is 4/sqrt(4)
The default reset bounds are pos_bound 2 and vel_bound 0
A reset draws position and velocity uniformly from the bounds
A reset reseeds numpy and torch when a seed is supplied
reset returns only the observation
step returns the 4-tuple (observation, reward, dones, infos)
reset replaces its options argument with self.reset_options
The default reward function is vec_hover_reward
vec_hover_reward adds a survival reward of 2, weights velocity at 0.1, body rate at 0 and action at 1e-5
_minmax_scale clips a scaled command to its bounds
The multirotor dynamics are integrated with rk4

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial draw from Python's random.Random and the kinematic update is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; upstream seeds numpy and torch and uses its own dynamics (quadrotor_environments.py:298-300), so a seed does not give the same trajectory on both

gaps: kinematic stand-in (F0): the fake integrates the commanded velocity of the default cmd_vel mode; it does not model the upstream rigid-body dynamics, rotor thrust, motor dynamics, wind or aerodynamics, and no forces or contacts are computed
the fake serves one quadrotor and collapses the upstream batch axis (num_envs); the real observation and action arrays carry that extra leading dimension
the fake models only the default cmd_vel action shape (3 values); the 4-value control modes of the upstream are not modelled
the fake honors the reset options argument; the upstream reset overwrites it with self.reset_options (quadrotor_environments.py:285)
the fake does not auto-reset on a terminal step; upstream calls reset_idx for every done environment inside step (quadrotor_environments.py:382-390)
the fake starts from Python's random.Random stream, upstream from numpy and torch, so the same seed does not produce the same trajectory on the two
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, commands alone advance simulated time by timestep_ms
the bridge maps the legacy dones flag to terminated and does not surface TimeLimit.truncated from the upstream info dict
no snapshot or restore: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no rendering, visualization or sensor model in the fake

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the last observation and tick stay readable
